audit.method: Every enumerated blob read from the specified Git tree; remoteFetched identifies a fresh verification ref. Source byte counts and canonical UTF-8 LF/binary hashes checked. All frozen edition hashes checked. Each unique immutable Git archive blob is decompressed once; every logical original entry is compared to its verified compressed/raw byte counts and SHA-256. No mutable-file timestamp or runtime-proof shortcut.

scope: Actual non-force atomic main/edition100/tag push, fetched and independently audited from Git blobs. Actual local-model data and creation workflows, source-derived checks, independent source and rendered-outcome inspection, layout and restart checks passed. Retained initial failures are part of the original evidence. Post-push CI is separate.

analysis.scope: Independent original CSV arithmetic, exact linked inputs, actual model receipts and rendered rows/count/filter/reset checks. No causal physics or speedup claim.

releaseCI.scope: Actual GitHub response after edition100 release push. Local validation is separate from this in-progress workflow.
